info.text: Well, we didn't find any answers about the growing evil in the world, but we sure did find a lot of treasure!
Spending the treasure on weapons and training will help you grow stronger. Never fear, we will find out what is plaguing this land.
I do feel myself growing stronger...Whoa, where are we? This place also looks to be savaged by wild beasts.
The Tauren elder Kronos is the lord of this territory. He has been leading attacks for the Taurens from the Tribal Plateau.
How do we get there?
The Orc Plains is just ahead. We must first pass through there before making our way to the Tribal Plateau.
Should we come across him, I will end his reign.
*whispers to herself* Thank the gods you may realize your destiny soon...

info.text: Brave one, I ran across an Imperial guard who was hurt in battle. I brought her here to see you.
My name is Elise and I am a temple warrior of the Yaloran Empire. Not long ago I fell into an enemy trap and was injured.
You have been very seriously injured, come with us. Dinah, can you heal her?
No, I am fine. I am sure I will heal quickly. But, please, may I accompany you to fight against Kronos and his minions who are ravaging this once peaceful place?
The further we travel, the more difficult our enemies are becoming. We could certainly use a real warrior like you on our side.

info.text: Elise has made it safely back to the temple and is passing along word of your valiant actions against the Taurens!
She is too kind. *clears throat* Anyway, is this the Tribal Plateau?
Yes. Kronos and his Tauren army are not far. They are soon to fall at your hand. But we must be on guard. The forces here are very strong.
Dinah, this place is dangerous. Perhaps you should head back.
I will follow you to the end; wherever that may be. Come! Let us tarry here no longer. Kronos is very near!

info.text: You worthless humans! All the bounties of Balenor will be ours once again. Bow and show respect to your new master.
Kronos, you have plagued this once glorious land and brought it to ruin. You must be stopped!
Hahahahah! I am the great Karnatog reincarnated! I will lead my people back to our glory days when Taurens reigned supreme over all other races!
Kronos, the time of the Taurens has ended. I will put you back in your place!
Muahahah! Big words for such a puny human! Come! Feel my steal in your belly!
